propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome values with provider-neutral contract including Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, and DelaySource enums to centralize retry logic across Cloud and Jira DC adapters.

Implement three-invocation, 15-second cumulative sleep fake-clock budget that prevents non-idempotent ticket writes from exceeding predictable request limits or being replayed after ambiguous commits.

Serialize outcomes through canonical_bytes seam to produce byte-identical UTF-8 JSON for equivalent states; redact diagnostic messages via sanitize_diagnostic seam and enforce 512-code-point truncation with eight-entry overflow sentinel.

After ambiguous write, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; return recovered if observed, commit_unknown with forbidden ReplaySafety if observation fails or is inconclusive, and skip replay if authoritative provider delay exceeds remaining budget.
